name: Molitva
source:
In the moment of suicide, when despair overwhelms the soul, a plea for forgiveness is heard. And God responds.

A chance granted from above – three days in the Borderland, a fragile world where it is still possible to find a path to liberation from sin. Here, the past comes to life, and each choice brings one closer either to salvation or to final oblivion.

When the past leaves you as nothing more than fertilizer for graveyard weeds, there remains only one question: Are you worthy of forgiveness?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3576940/Molitva/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在自杀的那一刻，当绝望压倒灵魂时，就会听到宽恕的恳求。神回应了。

上天赐予的机会——在边疆度过三天，这是一个脆弱的世界，但仍然有可能找到一条从罪恶中解放出来的道路。在这里，过去的一切都栩栩如生，每一个选择都会使人更接近救赎或最终的遗忘。

当过去让你只不过是墓地杂草的肥料时，只剩下一个问题：你值得被宽恕吗？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3576940/Molitva/]Steam[/url]]
